summary: LotusERP MVP end-to-end tested. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests PASS covering auth (register/login/me/401), products CRUD + seeded=8, parties customer/supplier + outstanding, invoices with tax/total/balance + stock decrement, expenses, dashboard (all 12 keys + 7-day trend), reports (P&L, GST rate-wise, sales register), seed idempotency. Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844 mobile viewport): login with admin credentials works, dashboard loads with hero + 6 KPI cards + 5 quick actions + top products + recent invoices + 7-day trend, bottom tabs navigate correctly, Inventory shows 8 products + 9 category chips (fixed 36pt horizontal scroll, no wrap) + search filter + product detail navigation, Parties shows Customer(3)/Supplier(2) segmented tabs with outstanding balances, Billing full flow works end-to-end (customer picker w/ 4 options → add-item modal w/ 8 products → line item added → generate → navigates to invoice detail INV-00002 ₹558.88 with correct GST breakdown), Reports screen shows P&L + GST 12% rate summary + expense category + sales register, Expenses screen accessible via qa-add-expense quick action, product add screen accepts inputs. Registration link opens register screen. testID coverage is comprehensive. No deprecated packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not used). SafeAreaView correctly imported from react-native-safe-area-context. No red-screen errors. Minor console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (harmless RN Web warning).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted (likely from react-native-web / gradient / vendor). Non-blocking. Reference: appeared when navigating dashboard on web preview.

action_items: Optional: track down source of props.pointerEvents deprecation warning (likely inside LinearGradient or a nested Pressable wrapper). Not user-facing.
Optional: consider adding pull-to-refresh on dashboard/inventory for better UX.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 575 lines is fine; if it grows further, split into routers/auth,products,invoices modules.
Invoices decrement stock but do not validate stock availability — a sale can drive stock negative. Consider adding a check.
compute_invoice_totals ignores per-line rounding which can compound; acceptable for MVP but note for GST-compliant filings.
GET /api/parties recomputes outstanding via N+1 aggregations per party — acceptable for small datasets, but should be a single $lookup pipeline at scale.
JWT_SECRET has a dev fallback; ensure production sets an env variable.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed invoked (idempotent) — admin@lotuserp.com/admin123, 8 products, 3 customers + 2 suppliers. Test data prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned where feasible; created 2 sale invoices (INV-00001 via API test, INV-00002 via UI test) and 1 test product/expense that remain.
